observations.text: default=str at the persistence sink can mask a future producer that puts a non-JSON-native object into detail (persists as str() instead of failing). Accepted (plan TASTE T3): producers bounded at origin; belt exists so one check cannot drop the whole report's persistence, which is what a YAML date label did at HEAD (silently — build_report's best-effort except swallowed it).

Agent-authored widget-type names now appear in message, read by MCP clients (operator LLMs) as a tool result. Bounded to <=5 names x 40 printable chars via _clip/_named; previously the same names travelled unbounded in detail.types — net reduction of the surface.

_clip collapses whitespace, so a quoted type "metric " (correctly unsupported — the agent server strips it too) renders as 'metric' x1 while metric is in the supported list. Confusing corner case, not exploitable; clipped-form-as-key is a deliberate plan decision.

Parity guard _literal_assign does not reject subscript assignment (valid_types[:] = ..., valid_types[0] = ...) or mutation through an aliased parameter; a starred element raises a bare ValueError (still a loud red). Test hygiene, not a security property.
